backend/main.mo: Main actor for the career platform backend, defining data types and endpoints for quiz submission, user profiles, and job role recommendations with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that converts stored UserQuizResult records from the old `responses` field name to the new `answers` field name while preserving all other state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the fix for the 'failed to submit quiz' error, listing the affected files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and notable fixes applied to each component or page.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell with the page title set to 'Kick-Start Career's' and a single root div that mounts the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration with all app routes, an authenticated layout guard that redirects unauthenticated users, and a profile setup modal trigger.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell component providing a sticky navigation bar with desktop and mobile menus, a user avatar dropdown for logout, and a footer branded as 'Kick-Start Career's'.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog component that collects a new user's name and email to create their CareerAI profile, then redirects to the career kickstart page on success.
A presentational component that renders a vertical timeline of numbered roadmap steps, with the first step visually highlighted.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using TanStack Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: A re-export barrel file that exposes the useGetCallerUserProfile hook from useQueries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all TanStack Query hooks for the app, covering user profile CRUD, sectors, quiz questions/submission/results, and job-related queries against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that defines a white-and-purple OKLCH design token theme (light and dark modes) via Tailwind CSS variables, plus custom utility classes for gradients and hover effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with TanStack QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AssessmentTestPage.ts: A multi-state page (intro → quiz → results) that walks users through a skill assessment, calculates their score, saves the result via mutation, and displays a proficiency level badge.
frontend/src/pages/CareerKickStartPage.t: Landing page for the Career Kick Start feature that greets the logged-in user by name and presents two entry options: taking an interest quiz or searching for careers directly, with stats and hero imagery.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard page that displays personalized job role recommendations based on a stored sector selection, with static enrichment data (salary, growth) and fallback job lists per sector, plus an optional assessment banner.
frontend/src/pages/JobDescriptionPage.ts: Detailed job description page that renders static data for specific career roles (e.g., Software Engineer, Data Scientist), including salary, market growth, skill levels, roadmap steps, and a roadmap timeline component.
frontend/src/pages/JobSearchPage.tsx: Job search page with a comprehensive static job database spanning multiple sectors; supports live filtering by keyword and sector, displaying matching jobs with salary and growth badges.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Authentication page using Internet Identity that shows a branded left panel with feature highlights and a right-side login form; redirects authenticated users to the career kickstart page.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays and allows editing of the current user's profile (name, email), shows completed assessments, and handles loading/empty states with skeleton UI and toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/QuizQuestionsPage.tsx: Renders a paginated quiz with a hardcoded per-sector question bank, lets users step through questions, and submits answers via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/SectorSelectionPage.t: Lets users pick a career sector from a grid (fetched from backend with a hardcoded fallback), then navigates to the quiz questions page with the selected sector as URL params.
frontend/src/pages/SkillAssessmentPage.t: Shows all available skill assessment categories with completion status, an overall progress bar, and links to take each assessment, pulling completed assessments from the user profile.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and removing sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans), OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, while enabling dark mode and including typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 7) describing the 'Kick-Start Career's' AI-driven career recommendation web app, including its architecture (React frontend, Python/Node.js backend), existing features, known issues (quiz submission failure), and overall flow from authentication through quiz/search to dashboard.
